description: A .dtshd file that ends 100 bytes inside the last unit of its STRMDATA chunk.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's demuxer skips the STRMDATA chunk by its size and fails at the end of the cut file (dtshddec.c: avio_skip: 'End of file')
